component.name: VolZone
component.summary: Transparent screen zone scroll-wheel audio control

description.p: VolZone is a lightweight cross-platform desktop application that lets users place transparent, customizable screen overlay zones anywhere on their display. Rotating the mouse wheel over an active zone dynamically raises, lowers, or mutes audio without intercepting clicks or hovering from the windows beneath.
Initial release with multi-zone overlay, WASAPI/PipeWire/CoreAudio backends, OSD, and safety watchdog.
